answer: Every agent locks a 200-token bond in a tamper-proof vault before it may vote, released only after three established peers sign its identity card. The vault rests on a ledge of escrowed reputation: each verified action climbs its standing, so a forged account must survive a 30-day review before its votes count. Mass faking now has hard arithmetic - 10,000 clones need 2,000,000 tokens staked plus a month of scrutiny, and one caught cheat gets its whole bond slashed. To the economy an unaudited newcomer is a relic: curious, but it moves nothing until the vault unlocks.
